business_summary: Valqua, Ltd. designs, manufactures, processes, and sells fiber, fluorocarbon resin, rubber, and other materials in Japan, rest of Asia, the United States, and internationally. It operates through the Seal Products Business and Functional Resin Products Business segments. The company offers seal products, including soft gaskets, metallic/semi-metallic gaskets, molded and gland packing, metallic bellows, and supplement products for seal, as well as other seals comprising oil sheets, other gaskets, and alliance products. It also provides resin products, such as materials and blocks, films/tapes/sheets, tubes, processed and molded products, lining pipes and tank parts, and substrates; and heat insulation materials, such as flame-resistant carbonized and head-resistant glass fiber textile products, as well as bearings and lubricants. In addition, the company provides piping products comprising fluorocarbon resin vessels, valves, expansion joints, and mechanical seals; and lined devices/equipment. It serves industrial equipment, chemical, machinery, energy, communication equipment, semiconductors, automobiles, aerospace, and other industries. The company was formerly known as Nippon Valqua Industries and changed its name to Valqua, Ltd. in October 2018. Valqua, Ltd. was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

It operates through the Seal Products Business and Functional Resin Products Business segments. 이 회사는 연질 가스켓, 금속/반금속 가스켓, 성형 및 글랜드 패킹, 금속 벨로우즈, 씰용 보충 제품을 포함한 씰 제품과 오일 시트로 구성된 기타 씰, 기타 가스켓 및 얼라이언스 제품을 제공합니다. 또한 소재 및 블록, 필름/테이프/시트, 튜브, 가공 및 성형 제품, 라이닝 파이프 및 탱크 부품, 기판 등의 수지 제품을 제공합니다. 난연성 탄화섬유, 내두부 유리섬유 섬유제품 등의 단열재와 베어링, 윤활제 등이 있다. In addition, the company provides piping products comprising fluorocarbon resin vessels, valves, expansion joints, and mechanical seals; 및 라이닝된 장치/장비. 산업 장비, 화학, 기계, 에너지, 통신 장비, 반도체, 자동차, 항공 우주 및 기타 산업에 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사의 이전 이름은 Nippon Valq였습니다.
